appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Increasing Production at Factory F from 2018 to 2023'.
The vertical axis is labeled 'Production' and has tick marks from 0 to 3,000 in increments of 200.
The horizontal axis is labeled 'Year' and spans from 2018 to 2023.
A single blue line connects data points for each year from 2018 to 2023.
The line starts at 2,800 in 2018, dips to 2,400 in 2019, peaks at 2,800 in 2020, then declines to 2,600 in 2021 and 2022, and slightly further to 2,550 in 2023.
The line is not strictly increasing; it shows a dip in 2019 and a decline from 2020 to 2023.
The line is mostly flat from 2021 to 2023, with a slight downward slope in 2023.
The line is consistently above the 2,400 mark for the entire period.
